paragraphs.text: Thabit of Almaaz was a Dominarian human song-mage from Almaaz who organized the Uprising in Epityr , a successful rebellion against the Sheoltuns .

Thabit's magical songs brought forth the Serra Angels , whose wings blotted out the sun during an entire day of fighting and whose courage and skill in battle helped liberate Epityr that day. This was the start of the fall of the Sheoltun empire as a whole.
